making another album and pursuing another deal, which was with Loud Records.
And you know, by the grace of God, we landed that record deal.
And now, okay, we got that record deal, but what do you do?
We don't want to do what we did before with this album flopping.
We have to really do us and not let anybody make any decisions for us and do what we came
here to do.

I'm a music person.

I love music.
